meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: 它把一项任务拆成极细的步骤:先按规范登记目标,再把每个动作同步到实时清单里,并要求每条成功标准都有可观察的真实证据。进度以检查点形式存在 .omo/ulw-loop,中断后按原状态接着跑。
howto.when: 当你要一个目标循环、需要长时间带检查点的执行,或提到 “ulw-loop”、“ulw”、“durable goal execution” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我登记这个目标,并拆成一步步的执行清单。
say.note: 会先读完整流程,再创建目标。

say.text: 查一下当前 ulw-loop 的状态,告诉我进行到哪一步了。
say.note: 会读取状态与清单并汇报进度。

say.text: 给这条成功标准配上可观察的证据,再收尾。
say.note: 会先确认证据存在再记录完成。

howto.what_en: It breaks a task into ultra-granular steps, registers the goal first, mirrors each step into a live checklist, and binds every success criterion to observable evidence. Progress is checkpointed under .omo/ulw-loop for resume.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a goal loop, durable checkpointed execution, or mention "ulw-loop", "ulw", etc.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to register this goal and break it into a step-by-step plan.
say_en.note: Reads the full workflow, then creates goals.

say_en.text: Check the current ulw-loop status and tell me which phase I'm in.
say_en.note: Reads state and checklist, reports progress.

say_en.text: Attach observable evidence to this success criterion before wrapping up.
